About me

A stronger story than a standard CV can show.

My background brings together front-line clinical training, public health policy work, telehealth operations, consumer health, medical affairs, and safety review. That combination allows me to work well where science, regulation, business needs, and stakeholder communication all have to align.

I currently work as a Safety Physician and previously supported medical affairs and regulatory affairs functions for global consumer health and MedTech workstreams. Across these roles, I have handled safety evaluations, evidence synthesis, scientific communication, claims management, promotional compliance, and cross-functional coordination.

My training also includes a Global MBA, postgraduate business education, and a Doctor of Medicine degree, giving me an added business lens when working with healthcare products, stakeholders, and strategy teams.
